name: nlp-refinement-cli
description: Durable-local, review-only refinement for natural-language-programming artifacts.

interface.longDescription: Guides durable-local review-only refinement runs through the separately installed NLP-refinement CLI, validates v4 NL-artifact reviews and human-only proposals, and can explicitly request two host threads with a requested read-only boundary while preserving SQLite receipts. Repair, MCP transport, and native-subagent guarantees remain disabled.
defaultPrompt: Use $nlp-refine to start a review-only NLP-refinement run for this plugin artifact.
